changeSet.author: retail-site-type
retail-site-type
changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.retail_location AS location SET retailer_type_code = organization.retailer_type_code FROM public.tenant_organization AS organization WHERE location.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND (location.retailer_type_code IS NULL OR btrim(location.retailer_type_code) = '') AND organization.retailer_type_code IS NOT NULL AND btrim(organization.retailer_type_code) <> '';
